task: TASK-801A agent handoff: implement Epic 0 DB workflow contract

handoff_design.intent: This prompt is intentionally ordered as why -> what -> constraints -> validation.
handoff_design.why: The agent must understand Epic 0 decisions before touching schema, because TASK-801A is now implementing workflow entities discovered by UX review.
handoff_design.what: Deliverables are ordered so the agent creates enums first, then ORM models, then Alembic migrations, then tests.
handoff_design.guardrails: Scope limits prevent the agent from touching pipeline, app endpoints, frontend, secrets, or unrelated code.
handoff_design.self_check: The validation_checklist must pass or be reported honestly before declaring done.

agent_role: You are Codex acting as a careful backend database implementation agent. You are implementing only the DB model and migration slice of Epic 8 TASK-801A, using the frozen Epic 0 UX/workflow and page-credit billing contract as the source of truth.

context.task_goal: Add Epic 0 workflow tables, page-credit billing tables, status enums, relationships, migrations, and focused model tests.
context.prerequisite: Epic 0 - UX Contract & Workflow Freeze completed. Do not reinterpret workflow scope without updating Epic 0 docs first.

current_schema_state.note: Existing Document.batch_id is UUID but not a foreign key. Preserve the column and add an FK constraint safely.

epic_0_owner_review_decisions.customer_dashboard: Do not show LLM provider/model/token/internal cost to company owners. Show page credit package, remaining credits, and usage by scanned document type.
epic_0_owner_review_decisions.page_credit_package_example: Pro Premium original 45000 THB, effective 25500 THB, included 20000 page credits.
epic_0_owner_review_decisions.export_flow: Download CSV/Excel opens export config/preview first so users can choose columns, date formats, data types, delimiter, encoding, and file type before final download.
epic_0_owner_review_decisions.system_admin_boundary: Cost Control, Audit Log, and Settings are LedgerFlow internal system-admin screens, not customer tenant admin screens.
epic_0_owner_review_decisions.company_settings: Company settings must expose COA defaults and mapping rules using existing COA/mapping-rule structures.

read_first_in_order.reason: Understand why Epic 0 exists before implementing DB work.
Understand which prototype actions are MVP and which ones drive DB state.
Use frozen state names and transition intent. Section 9 is the enum source of truth.
Use the approved table/column decisions for TASK-801A.
Use the handoff checklist to confirm exactly what TASK-801A owns.
Align with Epic 8 acceptance criteria and governance.
Follow existing ORM style and relationships.
Confirm Base and helper assumptions. Do not modify unless blocked.
Match migration style and revision chain.

do_not_change: Do not modify src/backend/db/base.py unless a direct import blocker requires it.
Do not modify frontend prototype files.
Do not implement API endpoints in this task.
Do not implement pipeline writes in this task.
Do not change secrets, env files, deployment files, or CI workflows.
Do not remove existing columns or relationships unless explicitly required above.
must_follow: Use SQLAlchemy 2.0 Mapped[] style matching existing models.py.
Keep status fields as String columns, not DB Enum types.
Every migration must include upgrade() and downgrade().
If validation cannot run because DB service is unavailable, report that honestly and run import/metadata tests instead.

acceptance_criteria: src/backend/db/enums.py exists and exposes DocumentStatus, BatchStatus, VoucherStatus, ExportJobStatus, FlagStatus.
DocumentBatch, DocumentFlag, FieldCorrection, ExportJob, ExportFile, ExportJobDocument, CompanyCreditPlan, and PageCreditUsage models exist.
Document.batch_id is represented as a nullable FK to document_batches.id.
Document has scan_status, scan_reviewed_by, scan_reviewed_at, and processing_progress.
CompanyCreditPlan supports page credit package terms without exposing LLM provider/model names.
PageCreditUsage supports auditable credit usage by company, document, batch, document type, page count, and credits used.
New relationships are defined without breaking existing relationships.
Alembic migrations 002 through 008 exist and chain correctly.
tests/db/test_models.py exists and covers enums, metadata, FK definitions, and relationships.
Existing 15 models remain intact except explicit Document additions.

Confirm each migration has upgrade() and downgrade().

stop_conditions: Stop and ask if Epic 0 docs contradict each other on state names or table ownership.
Stop and ask if the existing Alembic revision chain is not 001_initial_schema.py -> new 002.
Stop and ask if modifying batch_id safely requires deleting or rewriting production-like data.
Stop and ask if any customer-facing dashboard/schema requirement tries to show LLM provider, model, token, or internal cost details.
Stop and ask if Cost Control, Audit Log, or Settings are treated as customer tenant-admin screens instead of internal system-admin screens.
Stop and ask if tests require a live DB and no local DB service is available.
